UPSTREAM: mb/asrock/g41c-gs: Fix the SATA clock output on ck505 With reset default of the clockgen on this board the SATA clock which needs to be 100MHz depends on FSB BSEL straps. This explains why SATA was originally tested to be working but fails with CPUs operating at different FSB. This change sets a bit in the clockgen configuration which fixes the SATA clock. TESTED on with a 1333MHz FSB CPU. BACKPORT: FROMLIST: v4l: Add support for V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT The V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT mirrors the V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_CAPTURE with the exception that it is an OUTPUT type.
